name: Completeness and limiting magnitude
description: Artificial star / Sersic galaxy injection with a detection callback (default: the application's own extraction): recovery fraction vs magnitude (and size), photometric bias and scatter, false-positive rate, 50 % / 90 % limits written into the catalog (COMPL_* columns and catalog metadata).

params.name: kind
params.label: Injected objects
params.help: star = PSF stamps; galaxy = PSF-convolved Sersic profiles (n in {1,4}, random q and PA, Re in the size bins).

params.name: detector
params.label: Detection
params.help: sextract = the application's own ds9_sextract (uses the Extract tab thresholds); sep = SEP; or 'package.module:factory' of your own detection callback (see docs/completeness.md).

params.name: per-bin
params.label: Objects per bin
params.help: Statistical error of a bin fraction ~ sqrt(f(1-f)/N).

params.name: per-image
params.label: Objects per realisation
params.help: Objects injected into one copy of the image (kept apart by a minimum separation); many realisations are run.

params.name: psf-fwhm
params.label: PSF FWHM (Gaussian)
params.help: Used when no PSF file is loaded (Stars/PSF tab).

params.name: match-radius
params.label: Match radius
params.help: An injected object is recovered when a detection lies this close (galaxies: at least 0.5 Re).

params.name: re-bins
params.label: Galaxy Re bin edges
params.help: Comma list of half-light radius edges (pixels) for galaxies; the result lists limits per size bin.

params.name: crop-size
params.label: Central crop
params.help: Test the central N x N pixels only (0 = whole image); keeps big images fast.

params.name: allow-blends
params.label: Inject on top of sources
params.help: Also place objects on detected sources (completeness then includes blending); default: empty sky only.
